prompts: Use case: logo-brand. Create a highly refined original identity exploration board for premium industrial energy decision-support company spelled EXACTLY "WattTrace" (capital W and T, remaining lowercase). Landscape 1536x1024, flat presentation with generous margins and impeccable kerning, not a website screenshot. Warm latte #F0E6DB background, espresso #44312E marks, deep blueberry #353455 and pale blueberry #D7D6EC panels. Quiet, confident, exceptionally crafted. Main upper 60%: large distinctive symbol next to large custom wordmark. Lower 40%: three tasteful separated panels showing symbol alone, reversed lockup on blueberry, and a tiny realistic website navbar application with wordmark and "Request evaluation". Small top-left direction title as specified. No other copy. Consistent single symbol repeated exactly across applications. Must work as a solid one-color mark. No gradients, fake metallic rendering, shields, lightning bolts, gears, circuit diagrams, mountains, generic swooshes, stock infinity symbols or templated tech hexagons. Wordmark must read clearly; no invented letters. Original design, do not imitate any existing brand. This is an exploration, not a trademark-verified final asset. Direction title "01 / TRACE RIBBON". Symbol: a memorable single broad calligraphic ribbon, confident thick-to-thin curves making an abstract open W-like trace with two unequal troughs and a deliberate rising terminal, one short folded overlap and generous negative space. Human gesture translated into precise flowing silhouette, almost a sculptor's signature, no circular loop or infinity. More distinctive than a handwritten W. Wordmark: custom elegant contemporary serif, softly flared terminals, moderate contrast, beautifully balanced WattTrace, a subtle relationship between the paired t stems, upright and easily legible. Favor warmth and editorial authority. Main symbol espresso; lower alternate blueberry.
